title: Function approximation, gradients and the deadly triad

chapters.text: Start away from the minimum. Gradient steps: 0; Parameter w: -0.5; Loss: 3.12.
Take one gradient step. Gradient steps: 1; Parameter w: 0.75; Loss: 0.781.
Re-evaluate the slope. Gradient steps: 2; Parameter w: 1.38; Loss: 0.195.
Observe contraction or oscillation. Gradient steps: 3; Parameter w: 1.69; Loss: 0.0488.
Inspect the remaining error. Gradient steps: 4; Parameter w: 1.84; Loss: 0.0122.
